automation_evidence.quote:
each advisory being produced by a
closed-loop system which couples multiple LLM agents with a powerful crop simulator

metric_evidence.quote:
Agri-SCHOLAR beat the
regional package of practices (PoP) in every season

evidence.quote:
Each advisory is chosen using only the constructed weather Wt of that week (Eq. 17), never the future
observed weather.

practical_problems.note: cutoff-controlled rolling replay: advisories use only a 7-day forecast plus an analog tail from earlier years, then are scored under true weather; the cutoff is enforced in the protocol, not varied calibration: cutoff enforced by protocol in rolling replay, not varied.

evidence.quote:
With no bounds, performance collapses. Mean yield falls by 5.1%, production cost rises about 9.5-fold and the
sustainability penalty about 4.6-fold

practical_problems.note: ablation of the LLM feasibility bounds under a profit objective with costs and environmental penalties; loose and no bounds exploit the simulator with infeasible actions
the system is described as deployable but evaluated only in simulation; farmer pilots are future work

summary: Runs a weekly, cutoff-respecting advisory loop in which LLM agents bound actions and a simulator scores them, beating the regional package of practices over 11 simulated seasons; an ablation shows the bounds keep the optimizer from infeasible, costly actions.
